item.title: hackingbiology.com becomes the Foundation's site
item.description:
hackingbiology.com has left WordPress.com. The site is now a static, open build whose entire source — content, layout and history — lives in a public repository .

The reason is the same one that governs everything else here: the Foundation asks people to trust an open platform with their health record, so its own publishing should be inspectable rather than sitting inside someone’s hosted account.

item.title: Hacking Biology at the Fund Longevity rally in Rome
item.description: Hacking Biology took part in the Fund Longevity global rally on Wednesday 8 April 2026, in Rome, at Largo di Torre Argentina (Via San Nicola de’ Cesarini), 17:00–18:00 CEST. Rome was one of about twenty cities holding a simultaneous action — Amsterdam, Berlin, Brussels, London, Madrid, Paris, Prague, Stockholm, Tel Aviv, Toronto, San Francisco, Abu Dhabi and others — under one banner: fundlongevity.org .

item.title: Hacking Biology at the 2025 Longevity Summit, Dublin
item.description: Hacking Biology was represented at the 2025 Longevity Summit Dublin , held 2–4 July 2025 at Trinity College Dublin — one of the field’s more research-heavy gatherings, bringing together longevity scientists, clinicians and the advocacy and funding side of the movement in one room rather than the usual separate conferences for each.

item.title: Biohacking on Rai 1: Fabio Pietrosanti interviewed on Codice
item.description: Rai 1, Italy’s main public television channel, devoted an episode of Codice — La vita è digitale to biohacking on 27 June 2025, and interviewed Fabio Pietrosanti about the Hacking Biology project.

item.title: Radio Rai: "Io, biohacker, che testo sul mio corpo i segreti della longevità"
item.description: Rai’s Codice Beta — Ogni cosa è digitale devoted an episode to biohacking — season 4, episode 8, “Io, biohacker, che testo sul mio corpo i segreti della longevità” — with Fabio Pietrosanti on the protocol he runs on himself.

item.title: Speciale Tg1: "Pionieri di longevità — Biohacker"
item.description: Speciale Tg1, the long-form report of Italy’s main public news programme, devoted an episode to biohacking and longevity on 5 January 2025: Pionieri di longevità — Biohacker , by Barbara Carfagna.

item.title: Hacking Biology is presented to the Rapamycin News community
item.description: Hacking Biology was introduced to the Rapamycin News community — one of the largest and most technically serious longevity forums online — in a thread opened by the forum’s admin , who had noticed a new member “getting serious about longevity biohacking and in the process of developing his plan and a software platform”.
